question: Can a causal, selective 2D track-box trend provide reliable approach confirmation or contradiction without ego-motion attribution, metric TTC, depth, pose, IMU, or RGB decoding?

source_rule.input: same annotation track over seven contiguous frames
source_rule.confirm: slope >= 0.2/s and all six adjacent changes are positive
source_rule.contradict: slope <= -0.2/s and all six adjacent changes are negative

confirmation_instance.selection: metadata-only sha256 rank after excluding every outcome-open sequence
confirmation_instance.source: JRDB stitched 2D annotation box and track identity
confirmation_instance.firewall: freeze before selected payload access; seal 2D source output before acquiring 3D truth
